tasks.label: Install Build Dependencies (Mingw64)
args: pacman -S --needed --noconfirm mingw-w64-x86_64-cmake mingw-w64-x86_64-make mingw-w64-x86_64-avr-gcc mingw-w64-x86_64-avr-binutils mingw-w64-x86_64-avr-libc mingw-w64-x86_64-avrdude mingw-w64-x86_64-ninja && make

tasks.label: Prepare Build Folder
args: if (-Not (Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}/build')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path '${workspaceFolder}/build' }; cd '${workspaceFolder}/build'; cmake -G Ninja -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=${workspaceFolder}/avr-toolchain.cmake ..

tasks.label: Flash ItsyBitsy 32U4 - MASTER
args: Write-Host 'Double-tap the reset button on the ItsyBitsy 32U4 now, then press Enter...'; Read-Host; avrdude -p atmega32u4 -c avr109 -P COM8 -b 57600 -B 1 -U flash:w:${workspaceFolder}/build/skb_avr_atmega32u4_master.hex -U eeprom:w:${workspaceFolder}/build/skb_avr_atmega32u4_master.eep

tasks.label: Flash ItsyBitsy 32U4 - SLAVE
args: Write-Host 'Double-tap the reset button on the ItsyBitsy 32U4 now, then press Enter...'; Read-Host; avrdude -p atmega32u4 -c avr109 -P COM8 -b 57600 -B 1 -U flash:w:${workspaceFolder}/build/skb_avr_atmega32u4_slave.hex -U eeprom:w:${workspaceFolder}/build/skb_avr_atmega32u4_slave.eep
